subject: GreenStream vendor setup: insurance evidence, PO & tax details
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@greenstream.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenStream onboarding — insurance evidence + PO setup

Hi Sara,

Welcome — excited to get GreenStream set up with Redwood. To complete vendor onboarding and create a PO we need the following items from your side: 

- Certificate of Insurance (commercial general liability + professional liability), showing Redwood Inference, Inc. as an Additional Insured where applicable. Please include policy numbers, carrier name, and limits.
- Completed W‑9 (or equivalent tax form) so we can capture your tax ID for the PO.
- Remit address and preferred payment terms (if different from what you shared during the SOW discussions).
- If you have a vendor onboarding form, please send it back; otherwise the COI + W‑9 are sufficient for finance to open the PO.

If you can send the COI and W‑9 as PDFs today we can provisionally create a PO and share the PO number and expected payment window. Typical Redwood terms are Net 30; if AP needs different terms please flag.

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (blank form)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0187

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the list. Please find attached our COI and W‑9. A few notes below.

- COI: Carrier = Harbor Mutual; Policy #HARB-992345; GL limit = $2,000,000; PL = $1,000,000; Effective 2026-06-15 — 2027-06-15. We can add Redwood Inference as Additional Insured; let us know if you need the specific endorsement language.
- W‑9: EIN is 12-3456789.
- Remit: GreenStream Energy, 120 Market St, Suite 610, Seattle, WA 98101.
- AP have requested Net45 for new vendor onboarding; is Net45 acceptable?

I attached: GreenStream_COI_2026-07-19.pdf, GreenStream_W9_2026-07-19.pdf

If you need anything else to get the PO over the finish line, tell me and I’ll prioritize.

Best,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenStream onboarding — insurance evidence + PO setup

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the docs.

I’ve uploaded the COI and W‑9 to the vendor folder and started a PO in the system. Provisional PO number: PO‑78291. This is pending a final confirmation of the Additional Insured endorsement and review of the policy effective/expiration dates. A couple of next steps: 

- Can you confirm whether the COI includes the Additional Insured endorsement or if you’ll provide the endorsement PDF? The COI currently lists Redwood Inference in the Notes section but we require the endorsement in some cases.
- Finance flagged Net45 as nonstandard; our procurement team will escalate if needed but expecting Net30. If AP requires Net45 we will coordinate; do you have any contract clause that mandates Net45 or is this a preference?
- Please confirm the remit address shown on the W‑9 exactly as AP should use it (you listed 120 Market St — I captured that verbatim).

Forwarding the COI excerpt below for Markus's review for risk + indemnity checks.

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:38:05 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenStream onboarding — insurance evidence + PO setup

Thanks — reviewed the COI and W‑9. Two quick legal notes: 

1) Additional Insured: COI notes are OK but we need the specific endorsement or the carrier's confirmation that Redwood is explicitly named as Additional Insured with the same limits as the GL. Please ask GreenStream to provide the endorsement PDF or a signed letter from the carrier.

2) Policy timing: COI expiration is 2027-06-15, which is fine, but note the effective date is 2026-06-15 (coverage active now). No gap. If the endorsement is delayed beyond 30 days from today (i.e., past 2026-08-20) we should flag for risk/compliance.

I’m fine to approve PO‑78291 contingent on receipt of the endorsement PDF and final AP confirmation of payment terms. If AP accepts Net45 as a one-off for GS, escalate to Finance & include the commercial lead.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
